verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents first-party Prompt Caching that works automatically on all supported API requests with no code changes. Its rate-limit docs state that cached tokens don't count toward the uncached TPM limit, so a higher cache hit rate lets the same limit serve far more total tokens. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the latency (TTFT) gain or a per-token price discount for cached tokens, details on which models or prefix lengths qualify, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can benefit from prompt/prefix caching that reduces latency or cost on repeated context
